findings.description: The old code fetched all keys with one catalog.get_many call. The new code makes up to two catalog calls (exists, then get) per key per candidate locale. If the catalog is backed by a DB, file or network, this becomes an N+1 pattern, with up to 2*N*len(chain) calls per page bundle.
findings.suggestion: Use catalog.get_many(candidate, remaining_keys) once per locale in the chain, and only look up keys that are still unresolved.
findings.title: Per-key exists/get calls replace single batched get_many
